name: agentic-creator-marketing-infrastructure
description: Agentic Creator Marketing Infrastructure (CMI): a governed, MCP-enabled platform for brands, agencies, creators and autonomous AI marketing agents
author: Dhruv (iDhruv03)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
